branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A soft, industrial blue (persillé) cheese, a brand of the Compagnie Fromagère de la Vallée de l'Ance at Beauzac in Haute-Loire. It is made from pasteurised cow's milk.

sources.text: Its milk, maker and origin, from this page.
